title: Add 'check backend in PATH' helper to preflight
description: Implement checkBinaryInPath() in preflight.ts using 'which' on Linux/macOS. Use this in runPreflight to validate the selected backend binary before starting the loop.
acceptanceCriteria: runPreflight uses this function to validate the backend binary

steps.details: export function checkBinaryInPath(binary: string): boolean { try { execSync(`which ${binary}`, { stdio: 'ignore' }); return true } catch { return false } }. Note: use spawn(['which', binary]) instead of execSync for shell injection safety.
In runPreflight, determine the backend binary name from backend.name and call checkBinaryInPath(). If false, throw with install instructions.

technicalNotes: On Windows (not supported), 'where' is the equivalent of 'which'. This project is macOS/Linux only (per PRD) so which is correct
